groups.name: Misspelled words in ill-formed input
groups.change: No grammar change: correct the misspelled word (e.g. taht→that, teh→the, seel→sell) in the input or handle it with robust parsing.

groups.name: Missing open-class or specific lexical entries
groups.change: Add the missing native lexical entry with the indicated type (e.g. loch_n1 := n_-_c_le, vegan_a1 := aj_-_i_le, gig/megapixel as n_-_c-meas_le, consider as v_np-prd_sor_le).

groups.name: Missing, extra or malformed words in ill-formed input
groups.change: No grammar change: treat as ill-formed input with a missing or duplicated word (copula, subject, noun, preposition) and correct it or use robust parsing.

groups.name: Bare singular count NP (missing determiner)
groups.change: No core grammar change: treat determinerless singular count NPs as robust input, or add a robust-mode bare singular count NP rule if such input should parse.

groups.name: Informal or texting spellings
groups.change: Normalize nonstandard spellings (4→for, u→you, im→I'm, -in'→-ing, sooo→so, whatta) in preprocessing, or add marked nonstandard variant entries.

groups.name: Agreement errors
groups.change: No grammar change: treat subject-verb or determiner-noun agreement errors as ill-formed input or use mal-rules.

groups.name: Inch mark / inch abbreviation as measure noun
groups.change: Add measure-noun abbreviation entries (n_-_c-meas-abb_le) for " and 'in' meaning inch, so that number plus measure noun can modify a noun.

groups.name: GML markup not stripped in WeScience
groups.change: Fix gml.rpp preprocessing so GML link, template and IPA markup is fully removed and tokens keep their POS tags before lexical lookup.

groups.name: Missing verb-particle entries
groups.change: Add verb-particle entries (v_p-np_le / v_p_le) for knock out, line up, hand out and pull over, with the matching _p_sel_rel particle.

groups.name: Unknown word POS tag does not license generic entry
groups.change: Make preprocessing assign the correct PTB tag (NN/NNS/VB) to unknown words so the matching generic lexical entry unifies.

groups.name: Gapping in clause coordination
groups.change: Add a gapping construction that coordinates a full clause with a subject-plus-remnant conjunct sharing the elided verb.

groups.name: Noun ellipsis after adjectives
groups.change: Add a construction for noun ellipsis that builds an NP from adjectives with an elided or shared head noun.

groups.name: Straight ASCII double quotes
groups.change: Map straight " to directional quotes by position in preprocessing, or add " to the pt_-_dqleft_le/pt_-_dqright_le entries.

groups.name: heads-up with clausal complement
groups.change: Add a heads-up entry of type n_cp_c-optc_le that takes an optional that-clause.

groups.name: Orca replay picks wrong or unindexed lexical entry
groups.change: Fix Orca's replay so it tries every lexicon entry of the proposed type and unescapes TDL string literals when indexing orthography.

groups.name: Unlike-category predicative coordination
groups.change: Allow coordination of unlike predicative categories, such as AP and NP, as the complement of copular be.
